meta.title: A PR-created event's line item cannot be deleted below one
gaps: PR-created event setup is represented by awarded_rfq recipe which provides a live published event with one line item
warnings: error code 711 is not in en-IN.yml (or the backend checkout is missing) — the message cannot be checked

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted for approval).
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates (and publishes) the event, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You cannot delete this line item from the project”, and never with a server error.
